items.title: Cyberleek drops what they claim is a near-complete GTA 6 Xbox build online
items.summary: The leaker says they have posted a roughly 200 GB Xbox build from November 2026 and will release the missing main executable on November 23.

items.title: Japanese GTA 6 Players Can't See Nudity, And Take Showers In Their Underpants
items.summary: The Japanese release has less nudity and blood and fewer language options, and Rockstar did not announce any of these changes before launch.

items.title: Rockstar explains why you can't play darts in GTA 6: 'We don't have unlimited time'
items.summary: Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson says darts and bowling were left out because the team couldn't get them up to its standard.

items.title: GTA 6 Officially Reveals Mandy Actress
items.summary: Rockstar published the full GTA 6 cast and named Lexie Shoaibi as the voice and motion-capture actress behind the viral side character Mandy.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Now Available
items.summary: Rockstar's launch-day newswire post confirms worldwide availability on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, a final day for the Vintage Vice City Pack, a GTA+ bonus, and the release of the 34-track soundtrack album.

items.title: GTA 6 Launch Sets Livestream, Internet Traffic Records
items.summary: GTA 6's launch peaked at 7.91 million concurrent livestream viewers and set a new DE-CIX internet throughput record of 33.03 Tbps.

items.title: GTA 6 devs worried about layoffs despite making "biggest game of all time"
items.summary: A Rockstar Edinburgh developer wrote in The Guardian that staff fear redundancies after launch, though Rockstar has given no sign any are coming.

items.title: Where is GTA 6 Online Multiplayer? GTA Online 2 Release Window
items.summary: GTA 6 launched as a strictly single-player game, and the article says online is probably coming in 2027, citing Twitch's CEO and datamined multiplayer references.

items.title: Bigfoot Is Back In GTA 6, And Apparently He Smells Revolting
items.summary: Streamers have found a Bigfoot encounter in the Leonida woods, with a creepy effigy and a cutscene that fits the series' long-running Sasquatch gag.

items.title: GTA 6 Has A Hilarious Riff On Easter Eggs
items.summary: Players exploring Leonida after launch found a literal take on Easter eggs, one of many early secrets.
